data.title: Spot BTC, ETH, and SOL ETFs see record inflows amid macro pressures
data.description: Crypto ETFs just had one of their best days of 2026, and they picked a strange moment to do it. On September 14, spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in $160 million in net inflows, Ethereum ETFs attracted $121 million, and Solana ETFs added another $11 million, all while bond yields sat at elevated levels and…
